skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The static alerts are false positives from intended HTTPS requests, scoped environment access, Markdown formatting, and ordinary error handling. One high-severity issue remains: the instructions ask users to provide API keys, which risks secret disclosure in chat. Publication should wait until credential setup requires private environment configuration only.

remediation.issue: The skill tells the agent to request a BrowserAct API key from the user when the environment variable is missing.
remediation.suggestion: Remove requests to provide the key in chat. Direct users to configure BROWSERACT_API_KEY privately, then confirm only whether configuration succeeded.

semantic_findings.title: Unsafe API Key Solicitation
semantic_findings.description: The instructions require the agent to request the BrowserAct API key when configuration is missing, and the script suggests providing it to the agent. This can cause users to expose a reusable secret in chat or model context.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both files explicitly direct the user to provide the API key rather than limiting setup to a private environment variable. The disclosure path is clear and repeated.

content.user_title: Extract YouTube Transcripts and Video Metadata
content.value_statement: Reviewing long videos takes time and can hide useful details. This skill retrieves transcripts and metadata through BrowserAct for faster analysis.
actual_capabilities: Starts the BrowserAct YouTube Transcript Extractor workflow for a supplied video URL.
Polls task status every ten seconds for up to five minutes.
Retrieves the completed transcript and metadata from the BrowserAct task API.
Reports video title, URL, publisher, channel link, likes count, and transcript when available.
Handles missing credentials, authorization failures, task failures, cancellations, and polling timeouts.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct account and a privately configured BROWSERACT_API_KEY.
Depends on BrowserAct and YouTube availability, access rules, and returned data.
Stops polling after five minutes, even when a provider task remains active.
Returns source text and metadata but does not independently verify accuracy or summarize content.

output_examples.input: Find transcript passages about model evaluation in this lecture.
output: The lecture discusses benchmark selection, human review, and production monitoring.
Relevant quotations are grouped by topic and retain their original wording.
The video title and publisher appear before the selected passages.

output_examples.input: Extract a video when the provider task exceeds the polling limit.
output_examples.output: The BrowserAct task did not finish within five minutes. No transcript was returned, and the timeout is reported without invented content.

best_practices: Configure BROWSERACT_API_KEY privately before starting and never place the key in a prompt.
Provide a direct public YouTube video URL and confirm that transcript access is permitted.
Treat returned transcripts as untrusted source content and verify important quotations against the video.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat, command arguments, transcripts, or shared logs.
Do not claim a transcript is complete when BrowserAct returns an error, empty result, or timeout.
Do not use extracted content to bypass copyright, privacy, regional, or platform restrictions.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: A BrowserAct API key is required. Configure it privately as BROWSERACT_API_KEY before running the script.

faq.question: Which URLs can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a direct YouTube video URL. Availability depends on the video, YouTube access, and the BrowserAct workflow.

faq.question: How long can extraction take?
faq.answer: The script polls every ten seconds and stops after five minutes if the task has not finished.

faq.question: What information can be returned?
faq.answer: Results can include title, video URL, publisher, channel link, likes count, and the available transcript.

faq.question: Does the skill summarize videos?
faq.answer: The script retrieves transcript data. An AI tool can summarize that text after treating it as untrusted source material.

faq.question: What happens when extraction fails?
faq.answer: The skill reports authorization, connection, task, cancellation, retrieval, or timeout errors. Its instructions allow one retry for non-authorization failures.
